visualCharacteristics.purpose: inner-page title hero: either a full-bleed background photo with the page title over it (optionally with a text intro strip beneath), or a split layout with the photo beside a dark title/CTA panel

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = image (optional); row 2 = heading (h1 for page titles), optional subtitle/description and optional CTA link; optional row 3 = intro strip text (shown in a band beneath the photo). Image and content may also share one row as two cells. Default and split options render the split layout; image-dark, dark and intro-strip* options render the overlay layout

usage: Top of inner pages (offices, industries, services, about, community) and image + CTA banners such as the Indigenous Services promo.
reuseGuidance: Use for any single static page-title hero. No option = image half beside a title/CTA panel. Use image-dark/dark for a title over a photo, intro-strip for a photo title with a short intro sentence in a band below, intro-strip-stacked for a longer intro paragraph, split/split-cyan for photo beside title panel. Cyan options are colour hooks for the design pass. Rotating multi-story heroes use carousel-hero.
